notes.title: Crucial Hotfix for grevious error
notes.content:
I've made one typo in the current release, literally just one word misspelled, and it could permanently damage your project if you start it. 
Please restart Steam, before launching it the next time.

If you have been affected by this issue, which you will know because your project will have
1. crashed
2. failed to start

Message me personally on Discord (Folling#9999) or send me an email (contact@folling.de) and I will fix the project up for you - however, some of the data will be unrecoverable.

I made a joke about this happening a few minutes before this issues was reported, I should stop jinxing it.

Terribly sorry for the inconvenience, and I pray that no one has lost any significant amount of progress.

This also includes a fix, where text from the information tab entered in the previous version wouldn't be rendered in the new one. This is however fully recoverable for any project, in case you were affected.

sincerely,
Folling - Dev and Community Manager

notes.content:

More content updates are coming within the next few days, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Preview branch now live
notes.content:
> Hello World!

As announced some while back, we're now hosting a preview branch! 
If you'd like to help us more directly with new releases, be sure to check them out - note though, that this stage of the progress isn't necessarily usable. In fact, for now the preview branch cannot be used for your old data, and is unable to save data as well, it really only exists for us to get some assistance from the community with Quality Assurance!

To use this, you need to opt in for the preview branch:
right click ikarus in steam -> properties -> betas -> select beta -> preview -

Since this is before the full release, some features aren't implemented yet:

Fully usable
1. Blueprints
2. Instances
3. Attributes
4. Instance values
5. Folder system
6. Reordering
7. Shortcuts

Not implemented
1. Projects and save/load
2. Associative Values for attributes
3. Settings

Though it should be noted that this will not break your current data/projects, and they will be fully accessible in the full release!

For anything else you find, please let us know on Discord, or create a post in the steam forums prefixed with `[Preview]` so that we know it's not in the actual program.

Thanks for everyone who will participate here!
Folling - Dev and Community Manager

notes.title: Ikarus v1.4-beta is live now
notes.content:
Hello Worldbuilders, Gamemasters, Roleplayers, and Writers,

It has been a long time since the last release - but we're finally here.
After months of working on Ikarus, we're finally ready to present v1.4 beta to you!

There are a lot of changes, but I'll group them together.
Let me start out however that most changes aren't new features.
In fact there's only three new features really - and some other features aren't implemented yet.
This release was a mix of a UI-rewrite and a lot of preparation and conceptual conceiving to prepare us for the next few stages.

We're still in early access - please keep that in mind!

Patch Notes

New Features

 Any attribute can be a list now
 Folder system was implemented - and the reordering adjusted
 Performance improvements all around the board
 Add descriptions to Blueprints/Attributes/Instances
 Compatibility with older systems was improved - we now use OGL2.0 and Directx9 supporting graphics cards from 2004 onwards
 Fewer library dependencies on linux - which should hopefully help some windows users out
 Limited log-files - Ikarus will now create at most ten log files


Dropped Features

 Representations are gone
They were created to allow you to immediately see what an instance consists of without opening it - this will be handled in the future with a popup, where you can hover on the instance to see all its values - you now have to name instances manually


Features which aren't here yet but used to be

 Constraints - they were a niche feature anyway, and will be rewritten to work with JavaScript to make them as arbitrary as you - the user - wants them to be, this will come together with our plugin system
 Settings - they were mostly used as a placeholder to get some feedback on them
but we plan to implement them soon!
 Tableview - again, this was mostly a stub to see how people like it, but it will be reimplement in a lot better soon!


New Visual Features

 Completely new UI - far from perfect, but quite a step up 
 Colours are used in various places to help you orientate yourself easier
 A new font is in place - making Ikarus look at least 14 times better
 Cyrillic Characters are now supported - in fact we now support a few thousand characters - 
in the future we'll implement all remaining fonts, but make them opt-in to avoid a memory overhead of a few hundred megabytes.


As previously mentioned - old projects won't be able to be carried over into the new version - however, if you want your old project to be carried over, send us the database file, and we'll get back to you with a ported version!

If you've got any complaints, or bug reports, or suggestions - please report them in the steam-forums or join us on our Discord!

Thank you all for your patience by the way - we really appreciate it, and hope that this release will improve your experience with Ikarus!

notes.title: Important update for the next version
notes.content:
Heya all,

a bit of a downer for this one:
As we announced last time, Ikarus is going through some huge changes right now, this means that a lot of the things in the code-base will be fundamentally different. 

We have thusly decided that the next release - whenever it will go live - will be a breaking one. 
Breaking here means that previous projects won't be supported in the newer version anymore.

This was decided through a mix of analysing our playtime statistics, and talking through it for some time. 

We're very sorry if any of you have some progress that would be worth saving, though we do urge you to get in touch with us, and we will look for a solution on a user-to-user basis. 
Contact: 
- Discord (Folling#9999)
- E-mail (info@ikarus.world)

This will not happen frequently. We have a system in place that allows us to adapt the save files to newer versions though this version has so many fundamental changes adapting everything would take weeks, be extremely prone to errors and would need to linger in our codebase for months to come. I cannot promise that this is the last time this will happen (we are in early beta still) but it's very unlikely that it will. 

I will keep you posted, if we ever decide to finalise our decision on when we will guarantee a permanent safety for projects!

A positive side-note:
I have pondered a lot about Ikarus' layout and design and have come up with a layout that I believe to be a few orders of magnitude better than the current one, which will be part of the next release as well, so look forward to that!

Sincerely,
Folling - Dev and Community Manager

notes.title: A short update on the development process
notes.content:
Hey all!

We usually only talk about these things on our Discord, so for those of you which aren't on there, it might seem as if we're being very dead, which is neither the case, nor do we want to leave the impression that that's the case!

I have a long post regarding the details on our server, though here's a rundown of why updates have become less frequent:
We're currently trying to prepare a lot for the future, this includes, but isn't limited to:

 Figuring out how to properly store Ikarus' data, both in an efficient/performant and accessible way
 Setting up for HiDPI, including a better Font
 Setting up some more OS specific tasks, such as actually displaying our icon
 Switching our rendering backend to older versions of DirectX/OpenGL to support older computers
 Implementing Mac support


None of these features warrant a release on their own in our opinion, so we will group them all together in one big tech-update release in the near future.

Thanks for your patience!
Folling - Dev and Community Manager

notes.title: Ikarus v1.3b is released!
notes.content:
Welcome to the next release!

This is a relatively small release, though it covers some important aspects, and fixes some fairly crucial bugs.

Let's go over the list of features/fixes really quick:

Patch Notes

New Features

 Ikarus now saves which windows were last open, however they don't store the layout, so if you redragged/resized the windows, they will not stay in those positions
 Ikarus now features a fully fledged undo/redo system. You can undo any change you've done since you last started the app. Redoing works similar to how it would in applications like photoshop, where you can only redo changes you last undid until you make a manual change.
There are some known issues with this, which I'll talk about at the end
 We've added a read-only table view for instances. This is currently just experimental and we'd appreciate some feedback on it. You can't drag instances off it, or change values within it yet, which is supposed to be changed in the future.


Bug Fixes

 Using Choosables in a representation no longer crashes Ikarus
 Selectables and Reference-Lists are now rendered with a [ and a ] on each respective side


 Known Issues

 Undoing the deletion of a blueprint that referenced itself does not reinstantiate the reference-setting
 We're still aware of HiDPI issues


If you want to help us out, or mention features you would like to see implemented, come talk to us on our Discord or submit bug-reports/feature requests over at gitlab

notes.title: Ikarus v1.2b is released!
notes.content:
With a bit of a delay we're happy to announce that Ikarus is reaching its next stage. Most of the changes in this release have been architecturally, meaning most of them don't actually affect you users.

Patch Notes:

New Features

 The Representation feature has been completely reworked.
We have a short video tutorial for the new functionality available here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=98fBFmOpmb4&feature=youtu.be
We've attempted to port your old Representation into the new layout. We've tested this relatively thoroughly but you might still experience small inconsistencies.
 There is now a preview for References/Reference-Lists, simply hover over an instance to see its values in detail!
 You can now reorder Blueprints, Attributes, Instances, and Constraints in any way you want! I know this feature was very requested and it took us a few attempts, but I think the current setup is pretty sophisticated, though the detection for hovering is a few pixels off at times


Bug Fixes

 There were a few bugs with representations, those had been fixed, but those fixes are now obsolete, specifically deleting an Attribute cleared all Representation-Parts and you were able to select a non-Reference/Reference-List as an Attribute in a Part and then change it to a Reference/Reference-list.
 You were previously unable to add an entity (blueprints, attributes, representation-parts, instances) after you deleted another one that came before it.
 Deleting projects on windows failed sometimes
 The flashing issue from the previously mentioned post about epilepsy  has been resolved. I really don't want to cause physical harm to anyone. I urge anyone to figure out a bug with this to message us immediately so we can warn people with those conditions.


Performance

 Ikarus now runs a lot smoother on all rights, we've implemented clipping, meaning only data that is displayed is rendered. Whilst representations are technically slower than before, this drastically improves Ikarus' scaling with many entities. 
Clipping isn't perfect yet and you might be able to find things being rendered a little to late, or a little too early (though you can't detect the latter :P)
 We've completely rewritten the model and only rely on the database now, this is a huge improvement and will make work on future features a lot easier for us, whilst at the same time massively improving stability and performance all-round.


I hope you all enjoy this release and are hyped for the future!
I've mentioned it before, and I will again, if you've invested a lot of time in your project and it ends up being corrupted/crashed. Feel free to send us your data.db file on discord and we will do our best to fix it up for you manually.
This also helps us figure out what exactly went wrong, and how we can fix it for the future. That's the curse of being in beta.
Come talk to us on our Discord if you have troubles with the new release or just want to give us feedback or requests for new features!

Folling - Dev and Community Manager

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 released
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we've worked hard this weekend to release version 1.1

Let's start with some important information first:
Your old project will not be available per default in ikarus anymore. You'll see why in the patchnotes. If you had any progress that you think is worthwhile saving here's a guide:


 Open Ikarus
 Create a Project
 Close Ikarus
 Go to ${steam}/steamapps/common/Ikarus
 cut the "test.db" file

WINDOWS:
 go to %appdata%/ikarus/projects/Project

LINUX:
 go to ~/.config/ikarus/projects/Project

 delete the data.db file
 paste your test.db file
 rename it to data.db


and you're done should you struggle with this, or should it fail for you, message me on Discord: Folling#9999

We've temporarily removed macOS support, as there's an issue with getting Ikarus to run on it.

We're also aware of some problems on older systems, with older graphics drivers. 

Patch Notes:

New Features

 Implemented Project Feature - have multiple projects, one for each world/universe and switch freely between them!
 Implemented Colour Theme - You can now change most of the colours in Ikarus, should you not like the default theme. However - the colours are currently not saved, so you would have to re-set it every time you start Ikarus. This is mostly just to collect feedback for now. Thanks for MetroAndroid for the suggestion!
 Created the About Page to show love to our Supporters and the OSS licenses of awesome projects we depend on


Bug Fixes

 Using a Colour in a representation no longer crashes Ikarus - thanks to 
am18carpenter for the find!
 Using Constraints for Selectables/ReferenceLists no longer crashes Ikarus
 Any Entities (Blueprints, Attributes, Representations, Instances) are now displayed in the order they were created in, previously adding many of them would reshuffle them
 Range Constraints are now working properly
 Ranges can now be represented properly
 Representations no longer add an unnecessary space after the last part's postfix
 Deleting Entities no longer prohibits you from adding new ones


Visuals

 The "Instance Attributes" Button for Instances was reduced in size and had its text changed to "Values" - it still does the same thing, but leaves more space for representations, and seems more obvious
 Blueprint's Instances are now just called {blueprint_name}s
So for Character it would show "Characters", this obviously is terrible for internationalisation and irregular nouns, and we'll work on that once we include translations, however this will do for now.
 Instance-Attribute windows no longer display ${representation} Instance-Attributes, but rather just ${representation}
